Yanfly System Options Addon - Sections V1.00
Roninator2
​
Introduction
This addon to Yanfly's System Options script adjusts the window so that categories are displayed and the items shown are reflected by which category is selected.
It's a false selection as all controls remains in the options window.
Features
Allows you to create as many categories as you want and create as many items as you want.
If you want to have multiple variables selectable by the player? Then you can set up the categories to have as many as you want to show. If the list is too long then make a new category.
You don't need to have the player scroll down to see all the items.
